name: Leilon
summary: Small mining town and High Road rest stop on a mudflat at the edge of the Sea of Swords below the Sword Mountains; copper, nickel and silver mines and a palisaded town in the 14th century DR, abandoned after the Spellplague (1385 DR) and resettled under Neverwinter from 1485 DR, with about 200 residents and a revived fishing quay in 1491 DR.

identity.subregion: High Road between Neverwinter and Waterdeep, north of the Mere of Dead Men, west and south-west of Phandalin
identity.settlement_type: Small town (mining town and rest stop; abandoned 1385 to 1485 DR, then resettled)
identity.ruler_office: Lord Pelindar Filmarya (1357 to 1370 DR); town council loyal to Lord Protector Dagult Neverember of Neverwinter (late 15th century DR)

periods.pre_spellplague: 1357 to 1370 DR (Waterdeep and the North; The North: Guide to the Savage Frontier)
periods.abandoned: after 1385 DR (Spellplague broke the wards on Thalivar's tower)
periods.snapshot_5e: circa 1491 DR (Storm King's Thunder; D&D Essentials Kit adventures)
periods.note: Nothing is verified for 1492 DR itself. The Battle of Leilon (early 1490s DR) may have damaged or emptied the town.

position.note: Taken from maps/locations.json (anchor engine_position); not a canonical georeference. The stored engine position is the coords.json control point (L12, L13).

engine_record.population_note: No source. The wiki gives 3,000 (1357 and 1370 DR), none from 1385 to 1485 DR and 200 (1491 DR) (L6).
engine_record.read_from: faerun/data/store/settlements.json (2026-10-11); no business in businesses.json lists leilon; no route neighbours (L5)

town_plan.source: Labelled map of the rebuilt town, D&D Essentials Kit (2019); cartographer not confirmed
town_plan.orientation: North is up (compass rose); oblique painted view
town_plan.building_count_note: Not counted; the population of 200 and the plan's many roofs do not obviously agree (L6).
layout: Town on a rise above the shore inside a palisade and embankment, with the Sea of Swords to the west and south-west
Thalivar's tower near the north centre of the town
Town gates in the north-west corner, where the road arrives
Quayside along the west edge: sea wall, boardwalk, piers and boathouses, with the Fishery at its south end
Barge Yard and the Umber Hulk's Shell Inn outside the wall on the southern shore
Town Square, Tymora Shrine and Torver's Post in the east of the town
Tyr and Lathander shrines in the south-west of the town
Idol Island and three smaller islands in the bay
uncertain_readings: Label positions below are read by eye from the arrow tips
The palisade and ditch were described for the 14th century DR; the 1491 DR plan draws both
The 14th century DR taverns and the Temple of Waukeen are not labelled on the plan

markers.note: Rebuilt tower at the town centre; the 1485 DR order to pull it down is in the text, the 1491 DR plan shows it standing
Zana Taylish's arms and armour stall stands here
Aubrey's Peculiarities Shoppe, kept by a ghost
On Quayside; fish market and evening town hall
Harbour, boardwalk and piers on the Sea of Swords
Island in the bay; not described in the sources read

sketch.method: Label positions from plan_label_positions with the map frame offset; palisade, shore, piers, islands, roads and woods placed by eye; houses scattered at random inside the wall, not plotted
